name: radar-around-you
description: Live 3D radar of what is above, around and under you: satellites, aircraft, earthquakes, aurora. Prototype v2.

scripts.e2e: npm run build:snapshot && npm run build:sitepages && node e2e.mjs
scripts.build:snapshot: LIVE_BASE= node build.mjs src/main.js template.html dist/radar-snapshot.html
scripts.build:sitepages: LIVE_BASE= node build.mjs --site-pages src/main.js template.html dist/radar-sitepages.html
